title: code.submit-pr-verdict input
description: The orchestrated step envelope as code.submit-pr-verdict sees it. This is a self-round target: `code.orchestrate-review` rebinds its own session for one turn, so the envelope is the controller's, with `boundAction` set. The verdict is derived from `artifacts.resolutions`, not chosen — any `not-addressed` blocks an APPROVE unless `boundNote` records an explicit user waiver.

artifacts.description: `resolutions` is what the verdict is derived from; `postedReview` is the comment set it is a verdict on.

boundAction.description: Set to this action on the turn it runs.

boundNote.description: What the controller asked for this round — including any explicit user waiver of an unresolved comment. This is the text the user read at the gate.

gateApproved.description: True once the user approved the daemon's forced gate on this external write.

pr.description: Live PR facts kept by the watcher.
